name: fda-510k-five-year-recall
description: Will a medical device cleared by FDA through the 510(k) pathway appear in FDA's device recall enforcement reports, for a recall initiated within five years of the clearance decision?
split_description: Fixed chronological boundaries on decision_date, no random sampling and no re-splitting: train 2004-01-01 to 2013-12-31, eval 2014-01-01 to 2016-12-31, holdout 2017-01-01 to 2019-12-31. All three windows end at least five years before the recall snapshot (last_updated 2026-11-12), so every row's horizon is observed. No embargo is required because each row is a single clearance event, no feature uses a recall outcome, and applicant_prior_clearances uses only strictly earlier decision dates. Splits, label rule and horizon are frozen before any performance measurement.
